item.title: Jiayu Yao
item.description:
Hi 👋, I am a master’s student in Computer Science at the Institute of Computing Technology (ICT), Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS), advised by Prof. Shenghua Liu and Yiwei Wang. I am a member of the CAS Key Laboratory of AI Security.

My research interests lie in multimodal large language models, long-horizon AI agents, and reinforcement learning. In particular, I am interested in improving agents’ capabilities in complex, long-horizon tasks through reinforcement learning, as well as enhancing the reliability and alignment of multimodal models.
